description: List an MCP server or an ARD-publishing domain in this index so other agents can discover it. Give `endpoint` for an MCP server URL, or `domain` for a site that serves an ARD manifest. The submission is verified before it is indexed: an endpoint must complete an MCP initialize handshake, and a domain must serve a manifest that parses. Nothing is taken on trust, so a listing that succeeds here is one an agent can actually call. Free submissions are reviewed and listed within 30 days. Set priority=true to list now for 5 USDC (x402).

endpoint.description: Absolute URL of an MCP server, e.g. https://example.com/mcp

priority.description: list now instead of after review (paid, x402)

name: publish_resource
title: Publish a resource to the index
